name: Neustadt an der Weinstraße (Germany)
description: Black hoist charged with the city arms of Neustadt an der Weinstraße (a yellow lion on black), the fly divided horizontally black over yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Neustadt an der Weinstraße; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: black hoist, the fly divided black over yellow
